feature_details.name: danger
feature_details.meaning: wall/body danger as 3 bits: straight*4 + left*2 + right (0..7)

feature_details.name: apple_dir
feature_details.meaning: apple relative to head: rowSign*3 + colSign (row: 0 above/1 same/2 below; col: 0 left/1 same/2 right)

feature_details.name: heading
feature_details.meaning: current heading (0 up, 1 right, 2 down, 3 left)

feature_details.name: length_bucket
feature_details.meaning: snake length bucket (0 SHORT, 1 MEDIUM, 2 LONG, 3 XLONG); thresholds = fraction of board area (0.1, 0.25, 0.5)
